# Vacancy research: 1396 5th St, Oakland (APN 004 006900400)

**Verdict:** likely_vacant (0.88 confidence).

Oakland project records identify this as a vacant lot following destruction of the unfinished Red Star senior housing project in a June 2012 arson and its later demolition. The City’s June 2022 CEQA analysis explicitly calls the site vacant and undeveloped. An Alameda County Environmental Health Phase I assessment identifies vacant land with no permanent structures; its report filename dates it to May 2016, the earliest dated vacant-land documentation located here.

**Duration:** at least 10 years by October 2026, based on vacant-land documentation by May 2016. This is a conservative evidence floor, not the exact vacancy start. The fire occurred in June 2012, but sources reviewed do not establish the precise demolition/clearance date or uninterrupted vacancy since then. No current 2026 site inspection, utility records, or parcel-specific vacancy-tax filing was located.

Sources: [Alameda County environmental assessment](https://dehpra.acgov.org/Lopinfo/ReadFile?record=RO0002896%5CPHASE1_R_2011-06-07.pdf); [Oakland CEQA analysis, June 2022](https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/planning-amp-building/documents/dp/ceqa/2011-present/1396-5th-street-ceqa-analysis-updated-june-2022.pdf); [Oakland City Council record](https://oakland.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?GUID=78E33B97-CFF3-4509-BFD7-0A815CB5A50D&ID=5196424); [Oakland Planning Commission page](https://www.oaklandca.gov/Public-Meetings/Planning-Commission/2021/03-03-21-PC).
